catalysts.headline: Confirmed: SELLAS will present Phase 2 tambiciclib (SLS009) relapsed/refractory AML data as a poster at ASH 2026 (68th ASH Annual Meeting, New Orleans, Dec 12-15) -- Abstract 5155, Session 616 (Poster III), Mon Dec 14, 6:00-8:00PM CST, Hall F, Ernest N. Morial Convention Center. Title: 'Tambiciclib (SLS009), a highly selective CDK9 inhibitor, in combination with azacitidine and venetoclax in relapsed/refractory AML after prior venetoclax: Results from a Phase 2 study.'
catalysts.impact: Key data readout venue; company's Nov 4 release reported (n=62 heavily pretreated patients) 54% ORR/5.8mo median OS in monocytic AML and 57% ORR/8.8mo median OS in TP53-mutated AML, though a separate CancerNetwork (Nov 6) article cites a 34% ORR across all doses in a differently-defined n=59 population -- figures not reconciled, no concurrent comparator arm.

SELLAS reported Q3 2026 results: net loss of $10.1M (-$0.05/share) vs a $6.8M net loss in Q3 2025; R&D expense rose to $7.0M from $4.2M, G&A rose to $4.3M from $2.9M; cash and equivalents of $134.7M as of 2026-09-30; nine-month net loss $28.1M; reiterated that the Phase 2 SLS009 (tambiciclib) first-line AML data (40 of 80 patients enrolled) is expected in Q4 2026 and that REGAL Phase 3 (galinpepimut-S in AML) reached its pre-specified 80th survival event on 2026-10-28, triggering the final overall-survival analysis, with topline results expected in November 2026

catalysts.headline: SELLAS announced it will present positive Phase 2 data for SLS009 (tambiciclib) combination therapy in high-risk AML at ASH 2026 (New Orleans, Dec 12-15; one outlet cites a Dec 14 presentation date): among evaluable patients at the selected dose, a 54% response rate with 5.8-month median survival in monocytic AML, and a 57% response rate with 8.8-month median survival in TP53-mutated AML, versus a cited historical benchmark of ~2.5 months for each subgroup. Analysts note the absence of a concurrent comparator arm means these figures do not establish a survival benefit on their own.

Presented Phase 2 results for SLS009 (tambiciclib) in relapsed/refractory AML: across doses, 34% of 59 evaluable patients responded; independent observers noted the single-arm data do not by themselves demonstrate a survival benefit
catalysts.impact: Shares rose 3% to $9.14 on the news day but were still down nearly 6% for the week
